metadata.description: Oh-My-Pi plugins: an agentic dev team, a GitHub Copilot model preset, a token-reduction toolkit, and an Azure DevOps filesystem.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Agentic dev team (port of bdfinst/agentic-dev-team): orchestrator + 32 specialist/critic agents, the specs->plan->build->pr workflow, strict TDD and human gates, ~78 skills, and blocking guard extensions. All-cloud tiers.

plugins.name: azure-devops-fs
plugins.description: Azure DevOps as a filesystem for OMP: read repos/files/PRs/diffs via ado:// URIs, create/checkout/push PRs, comment/vote, watch pipelines. Standalone, PAT-authenticated, with a SQLite read cache.

plugins.name: copilot-preset
plugins.description: Ready, solid-but-cheap model configuration that routes OMP (and the dev-team) through GitHub Copilot, so teams run on their Copilot license. Config-only: paste the snippet; tier -> Copilot model mapping, post-2026-06-01 AI-credit/token pricing comparison, and MAI-Code-1-Flash ('MIA Coding') wired in for when it lands.

plugins.name: token-diet
plugins.description: Aggressive token reduction: ctx-wire for transparently compressed + secret-scrubbed shell output, CodeGraph (MCP) for symbol/call-graph queries instead of grep+read, a caveman terse-output skill, and a yagni minimal-code skill (ponytail-style). Layers on OMP's native compaction + astGrep; ships an always-on routing rule, MCP config, skills, and a setup script.

plugins.name: local-llm
plugins.description: Run OMP roles on LOCAL models sized to your hardware: detects VRAM/RAM, picks the best-fit GGUF models per role, installs Ollama (or llama.cpp), pulls the models, and registers them as the 'local-llm' provider. Hybrid by default (planning on cloud, execution/cheap roles local).
